AS151 and AS152 should each have a web host and a router, and they should each join a network. AS151 and AS152 should also join an internet exchange. The code should also set up BGP peering between AS150 and AS151, and between AS150 and AS152. Finally, the code should add all the layers to the emulator and dump the emulator's state to a binary file.

```python
from seed_emulator import (
    createEmulation,
    makeTransitAs,
    makeStubAsWithHosts,
    createNetwork,
    createRouter,
    createHost,
    WebServer,
    createInternetExchange,
    joinNetwork,
    joinInternetExchange,
    addPrivatePeering,
    addLayer,
    dump,
)

# Create the emulator
emu = createEmulation("three_as_emulation")

# Create AS150 as a transit AS with 4 routers and 3 networks
as150 = makeTransitAs(emu, asn=150, num_routers=4)
net150_1 = createNetwork(emu, "net150_1", "10.150.1.0/24")
net150_2 = createNetwork(emu, "net150_2", "10.150.2.0/24")
net150_3 = createNetwork(emu, "net150_3", "10.150.3.0/24")

# Attach networks to routers in AS150
routers150 = as150.getRouters()
joinNetwork(routers150[0], net150_1)
joinNetwork(routers150[1], net150_2)
joinNetwork(routers150[2], net150_3)

# Create AS151 as a stub AS with 1 router and 1 web host
as151 = makeStubAsWithHosts(emu, asn=151, num_routers=1, num_hosts=1)
router151 = as151.getRouters()[0]
host151 = as151.getHosts()[0]
net151 = createNetwork(emu, "net151", "10.151.0.0/24")
joinNetwork(router151, net151)
joinNetwork(host151, net151)
web151 = WebServer(host151)

# Create AS152 as a stub AS with 1 router and 1 web host
as152 = makeStubAsWithHosts(emu, asn=152, num_routers=1, num_hosts=1)
router152 = as152.getRouters()[0]
host152 = as152.getHosts()[0]
net152 = createNetwork(emu, "net152", "10.152.0.0/24")
joinNetwork(router152, net152)
joinNetwork(host152, net152)
web152 = WebServer(host152)

# Create an Internet Exchange and have AS151 and AS152 join it
ix = createInternetExchange(emu, "ix1")
joinInternetExchange(router151, ix)
joinInternetExchange(router152, ix)

# Set up BGP peering between AS150 and AS151, and between AS150 and AS152
addPrivatePeering(routers150[3], router151)
addPrivatePeering(routers150[3], router152)

# Add all layers to the emulator
addLayer(emu, as150)
addLayer(emu, as151)
addLayer(emu, as152)
addLayer(emu, net150_1)
addLayer(emu, net150_2)
addLayer(emu, net150_3)
addLayer(emu, net151)
addLayer(emu, net152)
addLayer(emu, ix)
addLayer(emu, web151)
addLayer(emu, web152)

# Dump the emulator's state to a binary file
dump(emu, "three_as_emulation.bin")
```
